title: Haven-1 thermal and resource coverage matrix
purpose: Coverage map for a representative public-source CAD and future integrated 1D + selected 3D study. Not a complete actual flight BOM, released design, validated thermal model or simulation result.

S6.title: Vast cold-plate / pumped loop / radiator explanation

S8.title: Vast/NASA ICES-2025-465: ECLSS Trace Contaminant Control Testing
S8.note: Supports trace-contaminant system/test approach, not full vehicle flight CAD/BOM.

public_reference_anchors.reference_note: Published ratings are reference/interface limits, not assigned mission consumption or heat. Pressure/habitable volumes are source metadata; outer CAD is not volume-calibrated.

rows.subsystem: Pressure hull, frames, shelves and mounts
rows.public_evidence: Main hull/secondary structures documented; overall exterior anchors published.
rows.proposed_study_element: Retain pressure hull, equipment mounts, deck and shelf nodes separately. Display wall is not a structural selection.
rows.heat_role: Conducts and stores heat; mechanical load paths also create thermal bridges.
rows.resource_accounting: Thermal storage; structural mass. No electrical consumption assigned.
rows.later_1d_method: Wall/structure capacitance and conductance network with distinct internal and external faces.
rows.later_3d_method: FreeCAD conduction model at mounts, penetrations and cold-plate supports.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: MMOD shielding, insulation and exterior coatings
rows.public_evidence: MMOD shielding and radiator integration documented; flight stackup not disclosed.
rows.proposed_study_element: Separate display shielding from candidate insulation/coating layers. Do not assign blanket identity to every exterior panel.
rows.heat_role: Reduces parasitic conduction/radiation; changes solar absorption and IR rejection.
rows.resource_accounting: Passive protection mass; no electrical draw assumed.
rows.later_1d_method: Multilayer thermal resistances plus external surface optical nodes.
rows.later_3d_method: Local layered-shell conduction / radiation at seams and penetrations.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Window, docking interface, hatch and tunnel
rows.public_evidence: Domed window and docking/hatch are shown; window diameter is 1.1 m.
rows.proposed_study_element: Represent panes/frame/seals and visiting-vehicle boundary as separate thermal interfaces.
rows.heat_role: Transmits/absorbs radiation; conducts through frames; forms leakage/thermal bridge paths.
rows.resource_accounting: Optional window/seal heater consumption only if explicitly introduced as a candidate.
rows.later_1d_method: Window/frame nodes, radiation links and Dragon interface boundary.
rows.later_3d_method: 3D frame/seal thermal bridge and window gradients.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Photovoltaic solar wings and generation
rows.public_evidence: Twelve wings; published 13.2 kW total peak electrical rating.
rows.proposed_study_element: Keep each wing/solar incidence surface; generated electricity must be separated from absorbed heat.
rows.heat_role: Absorbs solar energy, converts part to electricity, radiates residual heat; conducts via hinges.
rows.resource_accounting: Generates electrical energy; degradation, eclipse and pointing reduce available power.
rows.later_1d_method: Orbit/attitude-dependent generation plus panel energy balance and battery charging.
rows.later_3d_method: Panel/hinge conduction and shadow/view-factor study.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: MPPT and charge regulation
rows.public_evidence: PV and battery power functions documented; specific MPPT topology/unit not confirmed in reviewed sources.
rows.proposed_study_element: Add explicitly candidate MPPT/charge-controller envelope, not a claimed flight box.
rows.heat_role: Electrical conversion loss becomes local heat; regulation changes charge/discharge duties.
rows.resource_accounting: Consumes conversion loss; controls available charge energy.
rows.later_1d_method: Efficiency map, clipping/current limits and charge-control logic.
rows.later_3d_method: Candidate PCB/device/cold-plate thermal model.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Battery modules and BMS
rows.public_evidence: In-house battery packs documented; installed chemistry/count/capacity unspecified.
rows.proposed_study_element: Candidate module envelopes and BMS unit; CAD module count is an assumption.
rows.heat_role: Ohmic/electrochemical heat, heat capacity, temperature-dependent performance; BMS dissipates heat.
rows.resource_accounting: Stores and supplies electrical energy; tracks SOC, losses and reserve.
rows.later_1d_method: Electrical-equivalent battery + thermal nodes + BMS safety/charge bounds.
rows.later_3d_method: Module temperature distribution, cell-to-plate conduction and vent-path candidate study.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Power distribution and DC/DC conversion
rows.public_evidence: Power electronics tested; PDU heritage is publicly shown on Haven Demo. Haven-1 power functions documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Separate candidate PDU, DC/DC and protection/BMS functions; do not transfer Demo packaging as verified Haven-1 flight layout.
rows.heat_role: Switching/conduction losses; fault isolation changes downstream heat loads.
rows.resource_accounting: Electrical demand, conversion losses, fault/load-shedding state.
rows.later_1d_method: Load bus balance with losses and branch limits.
rows.later_3d_method: PCB/heatsink/cold-plate component conduction.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Flight computers, avionics and crew displays
rows.public_evidence: VCU flight computer and two stationary crew-control panels documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Keep avionics boxes, generic PCB regions and display heat sources as separate placeholders.
rows.heat_role: Dissipates electrical power; conducts to mount/plate; cabin-side surfaces exchange heat.
rows.resource_accounting: Electrical energy and computing duty cycle.
rows.later_1d_method: Duty-based heat loads and lumped/component temperature nodes.
rows.later_3d_method: VCU/PCB 3D conduction with candidate thermal interfaces.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: RF, Starlink and communications electronics
rows.public_evidence: Starlink connection and communication systems documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Candidate communications box/antenna interfaces; no specific private RF design claimed.
rows.heat_role: RF conversion/compute heat; antenna surfaces radiate/absorb sunlight; transmit duty changes loads.
rows.resource_accounting: Electrical energy and communications operating schedule.
rows.later_1d_method: Transmit/receive/idle duty heat and antenna thermal nodes.
rows.later_3d_method: Electronics conduction and external antenna radiation/shadow analysis.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: CMGs, GNC sensors and attitude effects
rows.public_evidence: Six CMGs documented; detailed positioning and heat maps unknown.
rows.proposed_study_element: Six illustrative CMG envelopes; include sensor loads and attitude as thermal-model inputs.
rows.heat_role: Motor/bearing/electronics losses; attitude changes sun incidence, shadows and radiator view.
rows.resource_accounting: Electrical energy; momentum-control duty; propulsion fuel for unloading if used.
rows.later_1d_method: Duty heat + attitude-driven environment coupling.
rows.later_3d_method: Local motor/electronics conduction; full-vehicle radiation view factors.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Lab payload rack and experiment lockers
rows.public_evidence: Eight MLE payload slots and published interface limits.
rows.proposed_study_element: Separate locker/rack air-cooled surfaces and scheduled experiment loads; rated allowance is not an actual mission heat map.
rows.heat_role: Electrical dissipation, possible biological/process heat; exchanges heat with cooling air and mounts.
rows.resource_accounting: Payload electrical energy; experiment-specific consumables.
rows.later_1d_method: Experiment schedule, duty and rack/cabin temperature network.
rows.later_3d_method: Rack airflow distribution and electronics hot-spot thermal model.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Crew accommodation, metabolism and appliances
rows.public_evidence: Four crew/private quarters and common area documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Add scheduled crew sensible/latent loads, display/lighting/appliance loads and occupied zones as declared study assumptions.
rows.heat_role: Metabolic sensible/latent heat; humidity and equipment heat; radiation to nearby surfaces.
rows.resource_accounting: Oxygen, food, potable water, electrical energy and waste production.
rows.later_1d_method: Crew/activity schedule and sensible/latent energy plus resource balances.
rows.later_3d_method: Cabin airflow / local comfort with low-buoyancy conditions.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Cabin ventilation, fans and IMV ducts
rows.public_evidence: Station ventilation fans and aft-tunnel IMV duct/quick disconnect to Dragon documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Representative cabin distribution ducts, fan count and dimensions are not a verified flight ventilation drawing.
rows.heat_role: Transports heat and species; fan electrical energy becomes heat.
rows.resource_accounting: Fan electrical energy, air mass circulation, pressure rise.
rows.later_1d_method: Fan curves, duct resistances and mixing volumes, including Dragon boundary.
rows.later_3d_method: OpenFOAM forced cabin/IMV airflow, flow split, stagnant zones and temperature/species transport.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Air revitalization, CO2 removal and trace contaminants
rows.public_evidence: Air revitalization/TCC hardware and public test approach documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Keep TCC filter and air-quality functions; CO2 removal implementation/geometry remains an explicit proposed submodel until sourced.
rows.heat_role: Filter pressure loss; adsorption/process heat; possible regeneration/heater loads depending on design.
rows.resource_accounting: Electrical energy; media capacity; air-quality resource margins.
rows.later_1d_method: Pressure-loss + contaminant/CO2 balances with candidate process heat.
rows.later_3d_method: Filter/cabinet flow uniformity and pressure loss; not proprietary chemistry replication.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Cabin air-to-coolant heat exchanger
rows.public_evidence: Crew air-temperature control and thermal/air-revitalization functions documented; exact HX hardware data not disclosed.
rows.proposed_study_element: Representative HX to couple cabin CFD to liquid loop; implementation/geometry candidate.
rows.heat_role: Removes sensible/latent cabin heat and transports it to coolant.
rows.resource_accounting: Fan and pump energy; condensate if moisture removal is modeled.
rows.later_1d_method: Effectiveness/UA model with air/liquid pressure drops and optional condensation.
rows.later_3d_method: OpenFOAM HX porous-loss/heat-transfer surrogate or resolved local channels after sizing.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Cold plates, thermal pads and conductive joints
rows.public_evidence: Avionics cold plates and pumped-loop heat path explicitly documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Add candidate TIM pads/contact layers to representative cold plates; actual material and channel shape unknown.
rows.heat_role: Conducts component heat into coolant; contact resistance can control hot spots.
rows.resource_accounting: Coolant flow/pump energy; passive TIM mass.
rows.later_1d_method: Component-to-plate-to-fluid resistance network.
rows.later_3d_method: 3D solid conduction / conjugate cold-plate CFD; resolve contacts separately.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Pump tray and coolant circulation
rows.public_evidence: Thermal Pump Tray and pumped fluid circulation documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Pump cartridges and redundancy arrangement are candidate envelopes, not confirmed quantities.
rows.heat_role: Transports thermal energy; hydraulic inefficiency and motor losses add heat.
rows.resource_accounting: Pump electrical energy; coolant inventory; pressure margin.
rows.later_1d_method: Pump/system curve coupling, electrical-to-hydraulic efficiency and transient flow.
rows.later_3d_method: OpenFOAM manifold/pump-adjacent passages only where geometry merits CFD.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Coolant reservoir/accumulator and expansion allowance
rows.public_evidence: Pumped thermal system documented; particular reservoir/accumulator implementation not established.
rows.proposed_study_element: Explicit candidate reservoir/accumulator for inventory, expansion and gas-management trade studies.
rows.heat_role: Stores heat; expansion and gas ingestion can change heat transport.
rows.resource_accounting: Coolant inventory, pressurant if selected, electrical conditioning if selected.
rows.later_1d_method: Mass/energy/compliance model; fill and expansion margins.
rows.later_3d_method: Local flow/phase-management study only after hardware concept selected.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Tubes, valves, bypass, manifolds and leak isolation
rows.public_evidence: TCS tubes, control valves and sensors documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Candidate supply/return network, control bypass and isolation valves; CAD branches are illustrative and not yet an interconnected hydraulic circuit.
rows.heat_role: Transports heat; pressure loss creates heat; isolation changes available heat rejection.
rows.resource_accounting: Coolant inventory/loss, actuator electrical energy and pressure budget.
rows.later_1d_method: 1D network with K factors, pipe friction, valve curves, bypass control and leak cases.
rows.later_3d_method: OpenFOAM selected high-loss junctions/valves; derive loss curves for 1D use.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: External radiator and space heat rejection
rows.public_evidence: External radiator explicitly documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Active radiator faces, panel number/area/coating/location are candidates; do not identify every visible white panel as a radiator.
rows.heat_role: Rejects heat by radiation; also absorbs sunlight/albedo/Earth IR; may overcool at low load.
rows.resource_accounting: Pump energy and heater energy if needed; rejected thermal energy.
rows.later_1d_method: Radiator energy balance coupled to orbit, attitude, eclipse and coolant loop.
rows.later_3d_method: 3D radiation/view-factor and panel temperature gradients; no conventional external-air CFD in orbital vacuum.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Heaters, thermostats, temperature sensors and control
rows.public_evidence: TCS sensors/control valves documented; particular flight heater layout/ratings not disclosed.
rows.proposed_study_element: Candidate heater patches, thermostat/sensor locations, controller logic and delays.
rows.heat_role: Adds heat intentionally; control modulates cooling/heating and electrical demand.
rows.resource_accounting: Heater electrical energy; sensor/controller electrical demand.
rows.later_1d_method: Closed-loop control with setpoints, hysteresis, sensor lag, actuator delays and failure cases.
rows.later_3d_method: Local heater/pad contact gradients and sensor placement sensitivity.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Potable/process water and ECLSS resource storage
rows.public_evidence: Life-support cargo/water stowage functions documented; detailed flight water architecture undisclosed.
rows.proposed_study_element: Candidate water inventory node/containers; do not assume ISS-style regenerative water processing.
rows.heat_role: Thermal mass, possible freeze risk, sensible/latent exchange; conditioning heat if selected.
rows.resource_accounting: Stored water and use rate; optional electrical conditioning.
rows.later_1d_method: Water mass/energy inventory and crew-use schedule.
rows.later_3d_method: Tank/line thermal gradients and freeze-risk conduction study.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Oxygen/nitrox tanks, pressurization and gas valve tray
rows.public_evidence: Oxygen/nitrox metering solenoids and gas tray publicly described.
rows.proposed_study_element: Representative tanks, regulators and piping; inventory/pressure/size/count unknown.
rows.heat_role: Gas expansion/conditioning, valve actuation and pressure-boundary heat exchange.
rows.resource_accounting: Oxygen/nitrox consumables, pressurized gas inventory and actuator electrical energy.
rows.later_1d_method: Cabin gas mass/species balance and regulator/tank thermal transient.
rows.later_3d_method: Local valve/tank heat transfer if required; avoid unsupported gas safety sizing.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Wet-trash, sanitation and stowage
rows.public_evidence: Eight wet-trash containers, vacuum venting and cargo shelving documented.
rows.proposed_study_element: Separate waste thermal masses and vent route; payload size/location of containers inferred.
rows.heat_role: Waste sensible/process heat; odor/contaminant transport; stowage obstructs airflow.
rows.resource_accounting: Waste capacity, vented mass, crew-resource throughput, optional electrical loads.
rows.later_1d_method: Waste mass/energy/contaminant balance and stowage occupancy.
rows.later_3d_method: Cabin obstruction / local ventilation and vent-path study.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rows.subsystem: Propulsion tanks, valves, lines and Saiph thrusters
rows.public_evidence: Published Saiph propulsion architecture uses nitrous oxide/ethane, RCS and deorbit thrusters supporting CMGs.
rows.proposed_study_element: Separate candidate propellant tanks/line/valve envelopes; CAD nozzle counts and locations not flight verified. Do not substitute satellite Hall thruster.
rows.heat_role: Thruster/valve/plume heat, tank conditioning, propellant expansion, conductive and radiative coupling to station.
rows.resource_accounting: Propellant inventory, pressurization, valve/electronics energy and conditioning energy.
rows.later_1d_method: Tank/feed thermal network, duty schedule, burn resource accounting and thermal soakback.
rows.later_3d_method: Local propulsion-adjacent conduction/radiation; reactive/plume CFD is a later separate qualified scope.
rows.stage_status: CAD coverage / model-definition only; no simulation or hardware validation

rules: Leave unpublished quantities null until a declared, sourced input or explicitly labeled engineering assumption is selected.
All equipment electrical input does not necessarily appear as heat in the same thermal node; account for mechanical, RF, stored and exported energy.
Heater and pump electricity are part of system power and battery resource balances, not independent unlimited inputs.
Gross exterior envelope, pressurized 80 m3 and habitable 45 m3 are distinct. Current CAD does not establish the internal fluid volume.
Forced airflow is required for the proposed cabin CFD; do not import Earth-gravity natural-convection assumptions into orbital microgravity.
Exterior orbital heat rejection is radiative. Conventional ambient-air CFD around the station is outside this study physics.
OpenModelica system model should exchange reduced-order interfaces with selected 3D submodels rather than claim every component is resolved in one mesh.
CAD routes and component adjacency are illustrative; thermal/fluid connectivity, leak tightness and mesh suitability remain to be checked.
No solvers were run for this matrix. No temperature, heater power, coolant flow, energy, optimization or validation result is claimed.
Do not copy the confidential-marked National Academies deck; use cited openly published company material and public technical papers.
completion_gate: CAD visual review -> freeze declared assumptions/volumes/interfaces -> select a first small thermal/flow problem -> numerical verification -> physical/model correlation where data exist -> system integration/optimization.
